genes.name: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
genes.role: Tumor suppressor that normally targets HIF-1; with it gone, HIF-1 drives VEGF and angiogenesis in this proximal tubule tumor

genes.name: Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome
genes.gene: Germline VHL tumor suppressor mutation (autosomal dominant)
genes.role: Renal cysts and bilateral clear cell tumors with cerebellar and retinal hemangioblastomas and pheochromocytoma

genes.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
genes.gene: Trisomies 7, 16 and 17; loss of Y in men (sporadic)
genes.role: Distal convoluted tubule tumor with foamy macrophages in its fibrovascular cores; the commonest kidney cancer in dialysis patients

genes.name: Hereditary papillary renal cell carcinoma
genes.role: Autosomal dominant gain of the growth-factor receptor gene, giving multiple bilateral tumors

genes.name: Xp11 translocation renal cell carcinoma
genes.role: Genetically distinct subtype of young patients; clear cytoplasm with papillary architecture

genes.name: Tuberous sclerosis
genes.gene: TSC1 or TSC2 loss of function (autosomal dominant)
genes.role: Tumor suppressors; carriers get renal angiomyolipomas (25-50%), cardiac rhabdomyomas, retinal hamartomas and facial angiofibromas
